actual_scope: Exact #7637 word (SYLforge's H5B frame-restored construction, vendored as data). Twenty swap-then-delete composites plus one joint hub re-settle and one exact-zero-join fix: each composite is a SWAP-NULL relabel of two helpers h1,h2 (born at chart 3, ending at V) at a chart where both are present, followed by the deletion of the recombined stay of one of them. Every ADD/SCALE at the {0} chart and at V is re-derived jointly and exactly so that all 1,569 final rows equal #7637's; a CLEAR+INIT of field 1504 at its zero point removes #7637's exact-zero join. Owned MOVEs (47) and peak 50 are #7637's; lifetimes 233 -> 234; each of the 234 CLEARs carries an exact certificate under #7620's rule. Conditional on #7637's premises, which are #7620's five framework assumptions and its CLEAR reading, with the changed entrance initial[457] = 281 inherited.
scope_change_reason: Removes 20 paid stops from #7637's word: after a SWAP-NULL relabel of two helpers the recombined stay of one carries no content the other does not already carry, so it is deleted and the hubs are re-settled exactly.
bottleneck_link: Reduces the complete signed paid invoice per native call by {2:-16, 3:-5, 4:-16, 6:+14, 9:+3} (20 fewer MOVEs, some re-ranked), helper targets unchanged; over 17 calls paid positions 109,023 -> 108,683, rank-weighted S 1424 unchanged.
stop_rule: One literal word with exact arbitrary-input row equality, legality, the interior edit list, exact certificates for all 234 CLEARs, column tests on the 223-pair census, complete invoice and a certified crossing.
